name: MotaWord
description: Translate your Drupal site into 100+ languages via MotaWord Active Serve — CDN-backed dynamic translation, no content duplication.
project_description:
MotaWord for Drupal translates your site into 100+ languages automatically. You write in one language; your visitors read in theirs. When you update a page, the translations update too.

 Features 
 
 Automatic translation, automatically fresh — edits to nodes, terms, menus, themes, and blocks trigger a re-translation behind the scenes. 
 In-page language picker — a language switcher is injected into every page so visitors can change languages from their browser. Admin-only preview mode is supported. 
 Custom language switchers — tag your own links with localize-page-as-fr , localize-as-es-MX , or nolocalize and the module rewrites them correctly, both for search engines and for visitors. 
 Served from a global CDN — translated pages are cached close to your visitors, so adding languages doesn't slow your site down. 
 A full language operations platform behind it — your MotaWord dashboard is where you manage everything about how your site speaks other languages: pick which languages to support, tune the AI translation, edit translations directly in a side-by-side editor, order professional human translation for the pages that matter most, request localization and DTP services for documents and assets, and keep your terminology consistent with glossaries and style guides. The plugin is the connector; MotaWord is where the work happens. 
 Multisite-aware — each site has its own configuration. 
 Drupal 9, 10, and 11 . 
 
 Requirements 
 
 Drupal 9, 10, or 11 
 PHP 8.0+ 
 A MotaWord account with an Active project ( sign up ) 
 An Active token for that project (found on the project page in your MotaWord dashboard) 
 
 Quick start 
 composer require drupal/motaword
drush en motaword
 Then open Configuration → MotaWord ( /admin/config/motaword ), paste your Active token, and the module configures itself from your project metadata.

 Support 
 
 Developer docs: https://www.motaword.com/developer 
 Live chat: https://www.motaword.com/#chat 
 Issues: file in the issue queue on this project page 
 
 
 Looking to send specific pages to MotaWord for human translation as one-off jobs? Use the tmgmt_motaword module instead — the two work side by side.
